explanation: D2 is always near maximum (9-10, sometimes 8 late in the episode). At D1 the value follows the state reached on the previous trial: about 7-8 if it was S1 (3-5 late in the episode or after an unrewarded S1), and about 0-3 if it was S2. At GO it follows the choice: 7-9 when choosing a2 (9 if the previous trial was unrewarded), and 2-4 when choosing a1 after a reward or 5-7 after no reward.
